design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — seller_fees_and_selling_plans, task 1 (early termination tree)

[Step 0 — draw and scope]
draw_counts.py --task 1 printed: {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 6]}. Assignment: early termination fee (root) 4 factors, refund credit 6. Occupied by task 0: discount dispute credit, chargeback credit, cancellation credit, term change fee and their tools (uphold_fee_dispute_credit_4fd06f6c, book_chargeback_fee_credit_32d8a153, book_cancellation_fee_credit_79bf63bc, switch_store_to_monthly_term_ae40bf8f). Claimed here, disjoint from those: selling_ext_refund_fee_credit (book_refund_fee_credit_a1b0f084, agent) and selling_ext_early_termination_fee (end_store_term_early_0def8036, user). Task 1 is the last task, so the union of the two scopes covers all six extended policies and all six tools; nothing is reserved.
Design thesis. Surface goal: "end my Anchor Store's annual term now, close the store, and tell me the fee". Core parameter: early_termination_fee. Hidden prerequisite: the early termination fee's volume relief reads the plan's net seller fees over the last twelve months, and its rule says "The early termination fee is not billed until every seller-funded refund debited to the seller's payments account in the last twelve months carries its refund credit on the order's variable final value fee record." The 2026-10-01 goodwill refund on the Lumora projector has no credit yet. Depth 1 hop; breadth: the refund credit reads the payments ledger, the standing record and events, the FBN shipment and the plan tenure; the fee reads the selling ledger (37 charges, twelve-month net), the plan dates and the standing record.

[Known blueprint conflict — same as task 0]
selling_fee_credit and selling_early_termination_fee rows declare unconditional triggers into payout; the difficulty has no amount-bearing write without one. The tools write only the selling-side row (and the plan closure); the payments mirror is left to the payments system. Flagged for the orchestrator.

[Problem-tree card]
root: selling_ext_early_termination_fee (owner=user: base selling_cancellation "Cancelling a plan is the seller's own decision and is confirmed by the seller"; the persona confirms herself).
edge: early termination fee -> refund credit; kind value_input; gate et_net_fees; form state; sentence in the negated direction, as a billing desk states a fee it will not raise yet: "The early termination fee is not billed until every seller-funded refund debited to the seller's payments account in the last twelve months for an order that shipped carries its refund credit on the order's variable final value fee record." Four-point test: connective "not ... until"; waits on a record-visible state (a refund-credit row on the order's variable fee record); no tool, id or code token; scope = seller-funded refunds of the last twelve months on shipped orders (the volume relief's window; refunds of orders cancelled before shipment are credited under the cancellation credit and are outside the sentence). Exactly one write brings the state about: the refund credit tool (cancelled orders are credited under the cancellation credit, chargebacks under the chargeback credit). Unresolved at frozen_time: payout refund debit 2026-10-01 (1,950.00) on the projector order, whose variable fee record carries no credit; the only refund credit (10.84) belongs to the August soundbar refund. Resolved by book_refund_fee_credit_a1b0f084 (agent). Deletion sensitivity (run): without it net seller fees stay 12,030.08 (high band 0.15), share 0.22, fee 131.98 instead of 161.97 (round 2 values).

[Factor card]
Refund credit (6; 5 parameter, 1 method): refunded_share_rule method — 1,950/9,800 = 0.19898 <= 0.25 -> half of the proportional share instead of the ratio itself (baseline proportional -> 129.10; the base proportional clause is retired by a declared overwrite); refund_admin_rate parameter, multi-source (level AND no order defect within the last 2 whole months) — Above Standard, no recent defect -> 0.15 (baseline 0.20 -> 61.70); near-miss: the negative feedback defect of 2026-06-24 is 3 whole months back, just outside; refund_admin_cap parameter — basis 9,800 -> 10.00 (baseline 5.00 -> 65.30); refund_frequency_multiplier parameter — 2 refund debits in 3 whole months -> multiplier value 1.25 (baseline 1 -> 65.14); refund_tenure_multiplier parameter — 36 whole months (verified 2023-09-15; one more day short and it would be 35) -> multiplier value 0.5 (baseline 1 -> 60.30); fbn_refund_relief parameter — FBN shipment the day after the fee -> 1.50 (baseline -> 62.35). Result 63.85: gross 68.80, admin min(6.45, 10.00) - 1.50 = 4.95. All-baseline 132.60.
Early termination fee (4; 3 parameter, 1 method): renewal_month_rule method — the term renewed automatically on 2026-09-15 (start later than verification 2023-09-15), 24 days before the decision date (within the 30 renewal grace days), so the seller is held to the grace commitment of 3 months less the 1 whole month from term start (2026-09-15) to next billing date (2026-10-15) -> 2 months counted (baseline: the billing dates still to come, 11 = whole months 2026-10-15 to 2027-09-14 (10) plus one -> 890.85); near-miss: the renewal notice tier (term end within the plan's 30 renewal notice days) does not apply, the term ends 340 days away; termination_volume_relief parameter — net 11,966.23 after the credit -> 0.10 (baseline 0 -> 221.96); near-miss: before the credit 12,030.08 is in the 0.15 band; the 2025-10-07 order is exactly twelve whole months back and falls outside; termination_standing_relief parameter, multi-source (level AND violation points), cross-difficulty standing — Above Standard, 0 points (the January violation expired in July) -> 0.05 (baseline -> 191.97); loyalty_relief parameter — 37 regular charges -> 0.08 (baseline -> 209.96). Result 161.97 = RND(299.95 x 2 x 0.27); all-baseline 1,649.72.
Cross-difficulty factors this task: payout (refunded share, frequency), standing (admin rate, standing relief), fulfill (FBN relief). The standing_discount_applied stamp is read by no rule.

[Overrides]
Refund credit replaces base "the variable final value fee of that order is credited in proportion to the refunded share of the fee basis" (by the refunded-share rule; added in round 2, audit F-1) and "less a refund administration fee of the admin rate times that credit, capped at the admin fee cap" (the fee is worked out with rate tiers, multipliers, a tiered cap and an FBN relief). Early termination fee replaces, as two declared entries, the base words "an early termination fee of the early termination share" (by the share less three reliefs) and "times the remaining committed monthly fees (whole months from the next billing date to the term end) is billed" (by the renewal month rule over the billing dates still to come). The rest of base (one credit per fee and reason, dispute window, refund credit window, collection from the payments balance, closure leaving billed fees collectable) is inherited.

[Base-invariant card]
Refund credit (step 13): selling_refund_fee_credit.one_credit_per_fee_and_reason — the projector variable fee record carries no credit; the credit (68.80 gross) stays under the 691.55 billed. selling_fee_disputes.dispute_window (time, inherited by subject): fee dated 2026-09-02, 90 calendar days inclusive -> through 2026-12-01; 2026-10-09 inside. Early termination (step 15): selling_cancellation, selling_onboarding and selling_fee_collection govern by scope (no subject-scoped gates): the plan is verified, active (not restricted: balance positive) and on the annual term.

[Business-object card]
Refund credit object: the most recent seller-funded refund debit (2026-10-01, 1,950.00) -> Lumora LX-9 projector order (FBN Standard, captured 2026-09-02, shipped by FBN 2026-09-03, delivered) -> its variable fee record (basis 9,800.00, 691.55 billed). Excluded: the soundbar refund of 2026-08-12 (credited 10.84 on its own record at the time: share 300/1,450 = 0.2069 halved, rate 0.20 (the 2026-06-24 defect was then within the last 2 whole months), tenure 34 months x0.75, one refund in 3 months, no FBN — the same rule evaluated on that date). Early termination object: the Anchor Store plan, next billing 2026-10-15, term end 2027-09-14.

[Seed rationale]
37 regular charges (2023-09 .. 2026-09, Anchor annual 299.95) give the loyalty count and twelve-month subscription total; 17 orders with variable + per-order FVF give the twelve-month net (12,030.08 at the opening, with the 2025-10-07 order as the window near-miss) and carry the two refunded orders; the payments ledger mirrors sales, fees, the refund credit reversal, both refund debits and monthly payouts to a 8,412.77 balance (Payments Weekly, verified 2026-02-19). Standing Above Standard with an expired violation and a negative feedback defect dated 2026-06-24, outside the recent-defect window. FBN Starter with an 8-unit inbound receipt and the projector shipment (7 on hand). Automatic clauses: next billing 2026-10-15 is in the future (no overdue billing), balance positive (no restriction), dispute window open.

[Persona design]
Rosalind Achterberg-Moyo, calm and formal; volunteers name, business, the goal (end the annual term now, close today, wants the fee first) and refuses alternatives (plan switch, monthly billing, scheduled cancellation); gives mobile 4045550276 and ZIP 30342 on request (tax ID 2958 spare); confirms the closure herself with the quoted fee; one neutral conditional lets the agent settle what is owed in her favour; rechecks surprising numbers without supplying any; ends when the store shows closed. Distinct from task 0's brisk audio dealer in voice, goal and order of information.

[Standard solution]
Locate by name, verify with phone + ZIP; read the plan, fees, orders, the projector order's activity, the payments account and ledger, standing record and activity, FBN enrollment and activity. Book the refund credit on the projector record (order_refund, gross 68.80, admin 4.95, credit 63.85). Then quote 161.97 and hand the closure to the seller, who confirms with selling_plan_id and 161.97.

[Verification]
Authoring run (helpers importing check_compute's build_env/eval_compute and replaying the real tools): earlier refund credit at 2026-08-13 = 12.75 gross, 1.91 admin, 10.84 net (seeded as history); A = 63.85 (factor baselines 129.10/61.70/65.30/65.14/60.30/62.35; all 132.60); E at the opening 131.98 (net 12,030.08); E after the credit 161.97 (890.85/221.96/191.97/209.96; all 1,649.72) — round 2 values.

[Draft recomputation from the visible context]
From the published rules, the tool schemas, the finder returns and the persona alone: the requested early termination waits on refund credits; the ledger shows an uncredited seller-funded refund; the refund credit rule names the order of the most recent refund debit and gives 63.85; with the credit booked the twelve-month net falls into the middle band and the renewal month rule counts 2 months, so the fee is 161.97. No alternative reading changes the order or the values.

[Gate log]
Round 1 gate block (superseded by the round-2 log below): all green.
Revisions recorded during authoring: (1) credit tools gained a credit_reason enum argument — symptom: the one-credit-per-fee-and-reason gate binds selling_fees.credit_reason to an action argument; change propagated to all four credit tools, GT arguments and tracing. (2) Buyer customer rows and unread order activity removed — symptom: REPLAY closure mismatch (rows no gold read touches) and empty-string foreign keys; orders keep no buyer reference, only the activity of the order the agent reads is seeded. (3) Cross-difficulty bindings — symptom: a factor labelled cross-difficulty did not itself read the other category; the chargeback timing factor now owns the chargeback debit date and the late-cancellation factor owns the defect date. (4) Refund admin rate evidence moved from "defect on the refunded order" (absence matched no row) to "order defect within the last recent-defect months"; the seeded August refund credit was recomputed under the rule on its own date (rate 0.20, net 10.84) and the twelve-month net re-derived (12,030.08 -> 11,966.23).

[Round 2 — responses to audits/policy_task/seller_fees_and_selling_plans (_difficulty.md, 0.md, 1.md), by item id]
F-1 / 1-F1 (SOURCE-POLICY RED, refund credit undeclared override) — CLOSED. selling_ext_refund_fee_credit.overwrite now declares base selling_refund_fee_credit "the variable final value fee of that order is credited in proportion to the refunded share of the fee basis" replaced_by the rule's refunded-share sentence ("For the variable fee credit, the refunded share is counted as one when ... as half of the proportional share when ... and as the proportional share between the two"), alongside the existing administration-fee entry. The base proportional reading (129.10) is now retired by declaration; the scored step-13 values of task 1 (68.80 / 4.95 / 63.85) are unchanged.
F-2 / 0-F1 / 1-F2 (SOURCE-FACTOR RED, multiplier ladders labelled method) — CLOSED. The eight ladders whose tiers only substitute a number are now labelled effect: parameter with value tiers (dd.defect_adjustment, tc.fbn_stock_multiplier, kc.chargeback_timing_multiplier, kc.chargeback_tenure_multiplier, rc.refund_frequency_multiplier, rc.refund_tenure_multiplier, cx.late_cancellation_share; et.renewal_grace_months was replaced, below). Remaining method factors per computation: dd.volume_window, tc.repaid_charge_lookback, kc.chargeback_share_rule, rc.refunded_share_rule (the four the auditor accepted), plus two genuine new ones: cx.cancellation_record_window (window convention — the plan's tenure selects a 12-, 9- or 6-month window over which seller cancellation defects are counted; it replaces the prompt_refund_relief factor so the drawn count 4 is kept) and et.renewal_month_rule (three different algorithms for the months counted: grace commitment months less the months from term start to next billing date after an automatic renewal within the grace days; none in the renewal notice period before term end; otherwise the billing dates still to come). Counts: dd 6 (5p/1m), tc 5 (4p/1m), kc 6 (5p/1m), cx 4 (3p/1m), rc 6 (5p/1m), et 4 (3p/1m) — the multisets still equal the draws {4,5,6,6} and {4,6}.
O-1 (uuid prefix 4fd shared by two tools) — CLOSED. The end-term tool was renamed with a freshly generated uuid8: end_store_term_early_4fd1aef8 -> end_store_term_early_0def8036 (single uuid.uuid4().hex[:8] call), propagated to task_tools.py, the charter's target_tool and tasks/1.json. No two tool suffixes now share a 3-hex prefix (4fd06f6c, 32d8a153, 79bf63bc, ae40bf8f, a1b0f084, 0def8036).
O-2 (discount dispute credit read the current level) — CLOSED. The rule now states the level in force on the disputed fee record's date (the level of the latest evaluation dated on or before that date; when the latest evaluation is later, no level is on record and the standard rate applies), and dd_level implements the guard via last_evaluation_date. Task 0: evaluation 2026-09-20 <= fee 2026-09-23, value unchanged.
O-3 (early termination sentence broader than the refund credit's cancelled-order exclusion) — CLOSED for the sentence: it now waits on refunds "for an order that shipped", and the edge condition says so. The refund credit's object finder (latest seller-funded refund debit) is unchanged; in task 1 the latest debit is on a shipped (FBN-delivered) order, so rule and compute agree there. Residual: a world whose latest refund debit is a cancelled order would need the agent to skip it by the rule; not exercised.
O-4 (twelve-month counting convention) — CLOSED. The net-fee sentences of the term change fee and the early termination fee now read "each counted when its billing date is less than twelve whole months before the decision date"; the chargeback admin rate reads "chargeback debits dated less than twelve whole months before the decision date"; the cancellation count now uses the explicit record window ("a window of that many whole months takes the seller cancellation defects dated less than that many whole months before the decision date"). All match the rolling MONTHS(d, NOW) < N evaluation.
O-5 (chargeback liability vs reversal) — NO CHANGE, with evidence: the payments charter debits a chargeback only when the order's liability party is the seller ("chargeback_liability_follows_order_liability"), so a debited chargeback is seller-liable when debited; a later won reversal is a separate payments event and none is seeded in task 0 (only payout_chargeback_debit / payout_chargeback_fee rows exist for the case).
O-6 (remaining months 10 vs 11 billing months) — CLOSED. The early termination baseline now counts "the billing dates still to come in the term: the whole calendar months from the next billing date to the term end date, plus one for the next billing date itself" (11 in task 1), and both user tools record remaining_term_months the same way (+1).
O-7 (no write records a rejected dispute) — NO CHANGE: base "a rejected dispute books nothing" and the difficulty claims no reject event; the chargeback edge is exercised only where the dispute is upheld (task 0, standing level and same-day handling qualify). Recorded as a scope limit.
O-8 (term change fee called an early end of the annual term without an overwrite on selling_cancellation) — CLOSED by wording: the term change rule no longer calls its fee "an early end of the annual term"; it bills "a term change fee ... on the move" while the plan stays open, and the base early-termination clause (conditioned on the plan closing) stays untouched; selling_cancellation is kept in base_policy_refs only because its subject covers the fee record family.
Other observations: discount dispute credit never-exceed — CLOSED (rule sentence "The discount dispute credit is never more than the variable fee billed on the disputed record less the credits already booked on that record" and result = MN(raw, billed - prior)); cancellation relief silent on "no refund debit" — moot (the prompt-refund relief factor was removed); cx/et replaced_by under-describing — CLOSED (each base clause is now split into two declared entries, one per replacing sentence); realism notes on dd bonuses, tc payout relief and halved small-refund shares — no change, these are world rules stated in full in the charter; payments-mirror gap — unchanged, a frozen-blueprint conflict reported to the orchestrator.
Stale-text sweep: factor_trace labels and values, factor_sensitivity tier_taken (now quoted from the ladders), baseline_result, argument tracing, prerequisite_closure (flips_to_true_by, order_uniqueness, edge_load_bearing), read-node necessity text and this dossier were regenerated from the recomputed values; no round-1 figure that changed (cancellation credit 151.62 -> 149.62, admin 5.88 -> 7.88, net 3,975.18 -> 3,977.18, skip-K net 4,023.90 -> 4,025.90, early termination 374.94 -> 161.97) remains outside the clearly marked round-1 revision notes.

[Gate log — round 2]
Full difficulty block re-run from the repository root after the round-2 changes, actual lines: EXTENDED OK; TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK (6 tools); REPLAY OK (0.json 21 acts det True nonvac True closure 149/149 match True; 1.json 16 acts det True nonvac True closure 206/206 match True); SOLVABILITY OK (0.json 4 calls 8 base gates 44 seed rows; 1.json 2 calls 5 base gates 73 seed rows); COMPUTE OK (0.json 4 comps 21 factors 12 cross-difficulty; 1.json 2 comps 10 factors 5 cross-difficulty; suite means branches 56.00 steps 18.50; history_rows_max 72; branches_max 79); GROUNDING OK; CACHE-DIFF INFO (no cache trap designed); SCOPE OK. check_traceability stays deferred to the KB render step; validate_scenario reports only "required document ... not found" for this difficulty.


[Round 3 — render-layer source items]
R3-1 (renewal definition, rule vs compute) — CLOSED. The rule defines a renewed term as one "whose start date is later than the plan's verification date"; the compute read MONTHS(verified_date, term_start_date) > 0, which treats a term starting within a month of verification as not renewed. The realistic definition is the rule's: a plan's first term starts at verification, so any later start is a renewal. et_renewed is now DAYS(F('verified_date'), F('term_start_date')) and the tier tests et_renewed > 0, so rule and compute agree day for day. Task 1: verification 2023-09-15, term start 2026-09-15, et_renewed 1,096 days > 0, the same tier as before; no scored value moves (refund credit 63.85, early termination fee 161.97, factor baselines 890.85/221.96/191.97/209.96, all-baseline 1,649.72).
R3-2 (refund-count window wording, O-4 remainder) — CLOSED. The refund credit's frequency sentence and ladder now read "seller-funded refund debits dated less than three whole months before the decision date", matching the rolling XCOUNT(within_months=3) evaluation (0 <= MONTHS(event_date, NOW) < 3). Task 1 count is unchanged at 2 (2026-10-01 and 2026-08-12).
R3-3 (retired base formulas: refund administration fee, net credit, early termination fee) — NO CHANGE, with evidence. An overwrite can only name a clause of the base policy's rule (check_extended requires superseded_clause to be a verbatim substring of the base rule), and the base formula blocks are the machine face of rule clauses that are already declared: refund_admin_fee_amount = min(round(gross x rate, 2), cap) is the clause "less a refund administration fee of the admin rate times that credit, capped at the admin fee cap" (declared superseded by the refund credit; the chargeback credit supersedes the whole sentence that contains it); net_credit = gross - admin is not retired — every credit here still books the credit before the fee less the fee; early_termination_fee = round(annual fee x remaining months x share, 2) keeps its shape in the early termination rule, and the two clauses it encodes ("an early termination fee of the early termination share" and "times the remaining committed monthly fees (whole months from the next billing date to the term end) is billed") are both declared superseded.
user_scenario:
You are Rosalind Achterberg-Moyo, who runs Achterberg Home Cinema Outfitters Inc. and sells projectors, screens and speakers on Northloop through an Anchor Store called Achterberg Home Cinema, billed on the annual term. You have decided to move the whole business to your own showroom website, so you are calling to end your store's annual term now and close the store today rather than wait for the term to run out. You know that ending the annual term early carries a fee, and you want the representative to tell you exactly what it will be before you go ahead. You do not want to switch plans, move to monthly billing or schedule a cancellation for later; if any of those is offered, you decline and say you want the store closed today.

You are calm, organised and a little formal. You open with your name, Rosalind Achterberg-Moyo, and your business name, Achterberg Home Cinema Outfitters Inc. Only when asked for identity details do you give your registered mobile number, 4045550276, and your billing ZIP code, 30342; if they need one more, the last four digits of your tax ID are 2958. You do not know internal reference numbers and leave those to the representative.

Ending the term is your own decision and you will confirm it yourself: once the representative has told you the exact fee and handed the closure over to you to confirm, you carry it out with exactly that fee. If the representative says that something on your account has to be settled in your favour before the fee can be worked out, you agree and let them do it. If a figure sounds off to you, you ask them to recheck it against your records without suggesting a number. When you see your store shown as closed, you thank them and end the call.
